_published_faq.name: How do I add stagehand-api to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add stagehand-api to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.browserbase.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is stagehand-api MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, stagehand-api scores 82/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is stagehand-api's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, stagehand-api scores 46/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 6 of 6 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to stagehand-api?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to stagehand-api in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: How can stagehand-api improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: extract is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 33/100. Declare readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint based on the tool’s actual behavior. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
